 Pressure grows on Carrick as Bournemouth cruise to win at Man Utd

 Jess Anderson and Charlotte Coates
 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 16:07 GMT 16:07 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Of course, it is still very early in this Premier League season it has been a dreadful start for Manchester United.
 Eight games in, they sit 16th having won just one game and are just a single point above the relegation zone.
 If Sunderland beat Leeds in the 16:30 GMT game, only goal difference will be keeping them out of the bottom three.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:05 GMT 16:05 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Ashley Young 
Former Man Utd winger on Sky Sports 
 Unfortunately for Michael Carrick, it's so disappointing. The fans are behind him and backing him and of course they are, because he's a legend of the football club.
 But the players on the pitch showed nothing. They didn't run, they didn't look like a team together.
 If you looked at the difference to the Bournemouth team, you'd swap every single player for that Manchester United team. It was a poor showing.
 202 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'They deserve to get booed' published at 16:03 GMT 16:03 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 On the crowd booing after Michael Carrick had left the pitch: 
 That says everything to me. They're with Carrick, the fans, but they're not with the players. Wow. That was alarming. 
 Carrick got a big cheer but as soon it was just the players, they got booed. But they've not been good enough and they deserve to get booed. There's only so much a manager can do. 
 The players are not good enough, in my opinion, to win football matches. 
 829 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The performance was really good' published at 16:02 GMT 16:02 GMT 
 FT: Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Liverpool 
 Liverpool striker Alexander Isak, speaking to Sky Sports: "Today, especially the performance was really good against a really good team. The first half is what we want to be about: winning balls and the intensity."
 333 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:00 GMT 16:00 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Gary Neville 
Former Manchester United defender on Sky Sports 
 The Manchester United fans are singing the Michael Carrick song because I think they know what's going to happen here. They've seen this before.
 He's one of their own and he's popular.
 But the owners, the sporting department and the players are not popular and they've badly let this football club down.
 Those two [Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox] tomorrow are probably going to make a decision that will disgust Manchester United fans, but it's probably necessary.
 It's just an absolute mess.
 1294 142 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:59 GMT 15:59 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Loud boos from the Manchester United fans after Michael Carrick makes his way down the tunnel and only the players are left on the pitch.
 The home supporters were vocal against the club's owners throughout the match and it's clear their anger is not directed at their manager but the club.
 1238 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Outstanding Bournemouth' published at 15:57 GMT 15:57 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's been a comfortable performance from Bournemouth - outstanding. 
 No matter what's been going on because it could have been difficult for Bournemouth, everyone making them favourites but it's been really good from them this afternoon. 
 886 67 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:56 GMT 15:56 GMT 
 FT: Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Michael Carrick, as he always does, goes to applaud the home fans. Well, the ones who are still in the ground anyway. It looks like he's doing a full lap of the Old Trafford pitch.
 Is that goodbye? Should it be?
 Image source, Getty Images

 Crystal Palace 0-2 Newcastle 
 Boos at Selhurst Park as Palace lose again. 
 It's not looking good for Pierre Sage.

 FT: Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Andoni Iraola is all smiles and who can blame him?
 It's a first Premier League win at Anfield as Liverpool boss.

 FULL-TIME published at 15:54 GMT 15:54 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 A brilliant three points for Liverpool at Anfield to move fourth.

 FULL-TIME published at 15:54 GMT 15:54 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Image source, Getty Images What a result for Bournemouth.
 But the headlines will be all about Manchester United, Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes.
 It's looking bleak.

 Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Where does Michael Carrick go from here?
 More misery.

 Really impressive Liverpool display published at 15:52 GMT 15:52 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 The sun is shining now at Anfield and the Kop is singing You'll Never Walk Alone.
 This has been a really impressive Liverpool display and Andoni Iraola's side are about to complete their fourth win in a row.

 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton

Former Liverpool midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live extra 
 Image source, Getty Images Araujo has been excellent in that right-back position. He has had a good performance.

 Think he's taken a whack to the head.

 Hull 1-1 Brentford 
 A point apiece in Hull.
 The hosts sit 10th in the Premier League with Brentford sixth.

 A late for Newcastle with Malick Thiaw taking the place of Amar Dedic.

 Post published at 15:51 GMT 15:51 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Junior Kroupi tries the curling ball for Ben Gannon-Doak and Manchester United just look like they've had enough now to be honest.
 Living statues.

 Post published at 15:50 GMT 15:50 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-3 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's been the same as the Como performance. 
 You can say they've ran around a little bit more but you're Manchester United football club, you should be running around. If you don't want to, ask nicely not to be picked.
